verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe defining dashboards, data sources and configuration as code for automated testing and deployment through CI/CD pipelines. They also document a terminal CLI that handles authentication, multiple environments and admin tasks, and is described as suitable for CI/CD. File-based provisioning, an official CLI page and a published OpenAPI spec back up headless, scriptable operation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and detailed evidence of non-interactive auth and pipeline examples.
